arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Chuang argued for a uniform custody standard. She cited a four-decade legal history. She emphasized restraint associated with formal arrest.
Ms. Allen clarified the record for the Court. She noted the district court found parents were denied access. She defended the lower court's factual finding.
Mr. Elwood argued the Ninth Circuit erred. He stated age and experience must not be considered. He opposed the lower court's custody test.
